description: Search the published references of a public collection. Collections store references, not copied content. They start private. Owner search reads current files in owned bases and published files in other bases. Publication includes only references to currently public bases; private bases and later additions stay out. Every public read checks base publication again. Private or withdrawn collections return 404. Responses use private, no-store.

after.description: Document cursor from the next-page URL. Do not construct it.

collection_id.description: The 64-character ID returned by this API.

q.description: 3–160 characters. Uses the existing MySQL FULLTEXT phrase search in document bodies.
